method: tools/derive-water-actors.mjs over a read-only native trace of the recorded winning route

podoboo.note: remake feet y = native y + 24; v0 6.2 is the mean of 5.9-6.5 fitted per jump (apex native y 64-90); relaunch at native y 254

swimCheepGenerator.note: Free play only (the recorded route replays its own list). 2-2/7-2 water: each frame, once the 32-frame timer is 0 and the lowest free enemy slot s is below 3, a Cheep appears at camera + 287 (then the timer restarts). Random byte s (RAM 0x7A7+s): id = highId when >= 170, else lowId; height = heights[q] where q = byte & 7, moved up (mod 8) past heights already used; all 8 used -> bag empties; it also empties on an area load. Free-play first lives: 129/135 heights, 186/187 ids (evidence/swimcheep-findings-20261111.md). Stop camera: between the last spawn and the first refused free slot (2-2 2661..2737, 7-2 2533..2595), midpoint taken. Bob (+-15 px) is unexplained by the register: generated fish do not bob.
